question: What alternative mantra-empowered substance may be used to perform the prescribed rite?
premises: The five cow-products are named as a ritual substance.
The particle vā marks an alternative option.
The substance is specified as joined with mantra.
An agent should cause the rite to be performed with it.
inference: The rite may alternatively be performed using the five cow-products empowered by mantra.
plain_english: Or there one should have the rite performed with the five cow-products joined with mantra.
